chapter_note: An exceptionally pure substrate chapter. The entire teaching — the four-fold distribution of the ruling-power (ten firmaments, eight earths, walls/vessels, stellar sphere), the binding of cosmic leaders to the wheel, and the king-kingdom structural correspondence — stays within the cosmic system throughout. No institutional, editorial bridge, or exhortation vocabulary detected. The only editorial material is the dialogue frame opening formula in P1 and the first-person closure in P9. The seam flag on P9 is a false positive: the bridge connective 'Now, just as' returns the king analogy to cosmic application rather than bridging to institutional content. Teaching purity 0.921 is confirmed by close reading.

paragraphs.core_text: The wheel of the stars is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'Once again the enlightener speaks:' (dialogue frame attribution) and 'which is displayed to you' (dialogue address to audience).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening formula is standard dialogue frame. The substantive content — wheel of stars as one of four great things, ruling-power assigned to four parts — sets up the chapter's four-fold enumeration structure. This is the teaching premise.

paragraphs.core_text: The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.
paragraphs.temporal_note: First element of four-fold enumeration. Systematic cosmic geography: ten firmaments above the wheel, ruling-power imprisoned within. Both sides of the mapping are internal to the cosmic system. High substrate score (29.73) confirmed.

paragraphs.core_text: The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Second element of enumeration. Eight earths subdivided into four composite and four dark. 'Upon which mankind walks' is a spatial reference marker, not editorial application — it locates the boundary within the cosmic structure. Substrate score registers 0.0 because tracked vocabulary terms are absent, but content is entirely cosmological.

paragraphs.core_text: The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Third element of enumeration. Cosmic architecture: walls, vessels, four mountains, three vessels. The 'powers who are masters over them' maps cosmic hierarchy. All internal to the system.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [ ... m]any [ ... ]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of] the living.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Fourth and final element of enumeration. Lacunae in the middle obscure some content. Father of Life and Mother of the living are cosmic agents within the emanation hierarchy. The four-fold structure is now complete.

paragraphs.core_text: ⟨p.119⟩ Its [ ... ] very [ ... ] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Cosmic process description: how leaders from the three parts were gathered and bound on the wheel. Impersonal, systematic, process-oriented voice. 'Distributed, entwined, and weighted' describes the cosmic mechanics of binding. The 'titanic figures' is a striking term — possible Greek-influenced cosmological vocabulary in the Coptic translation.

paragraphs.core_text: Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Elaborate cosmological explanation of the wheel's mediating function. Three-part logical structure: (1) heavens couldn't bear them, (2) earths couldn't bear them, (3) therefore the wheel. Then the wheel's dual function: receiving light from below upward, distributing cold/hot from above downward. This is cosmic mechanics — the wheel as conduit between upper and lower domains. Both sides stay within the cosmic system throughout.

paragraphs.core_text: Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [ ... ] property [ ... ] and those cattle [ ... ] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The king-kingdom analogy is a STRUCTURAL CORRESPONDENCE — ruler matched to totality of domain. This is not application to contemporary institutions but an archetypal mapping expressing the cosmic principle. No contemporary persons, institutions, or religious practices named. The king is a type, not a historical figure. 'Behold' is a common teaching introducer in the tradition. The principle — that ruler equals domain — is the same correspondential principle that governs the cosmic architecture being taught.

paragraphs.core_text: Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed 'the totality being gathered in to them the way that I have told you. I have opened your eyes!' — first-person dialogue frame closure with self-referential summary and direct address. 'The way that I have told you' and 'I have opened your eyes' are speaker self-reference characteristic of the dialogue frame layer.
paragraphs.temporal_note: The seam flag is a false positive. 'Now, just as' bridges the king analogy BACK to the cosmic system, not outward to institutional content. Seven leaders (planets) and twelve zodiac signs are cosmic architecture. The content maps the structural correspondence from P8 onto the cosmic reality it was designed to illuminate. The only non-substrate material is the final first-person closure. The teaching itself — that the seven planetary leaders and twelve zodiac signs govern the entire created order — is foundational cosmological-correspondential content.
